lines.speaker: momo
lines.text: Can I ask you something about distances in space?

lines.speaker: momo
lines.text: What's a light-year? Is it a long time?

lines.speaker: ravi
lines.text: It's a distance: how far light travels in one year. About nine trillion kilometres!

lines.speaker: ravi
lines.text: Seen as they were long ago. Light from some stars left them thousands of years ago. Looking far is looking back in time.
